hero.description: We plan, engineer and deliver complex building, infrastructure and industrial projects — on programme, to specification, and to standards that hold up decades later.
hero.imageAlt: Modern high-rise construction site at dusk with tower cranes silhouetted against the sky

intro.heading: A construction partner built on engineering rigour.
intro.lead: Meridian brings together structural engineers, project managers and site teams under one accountable organisation. We take responsibility from first sketch to final handover.
intro.body1: Every project we take on begins with the same question: how will this be built, and how will it still perform in fifty years? That question shapes our drawings, our procurement, and the sequence in which our teams work.
intro.body2: We operate as a single integrated practice. Design, engineering, procurement and construction are not handed between separate companies — they sit in one room, sharing one programme and one standard of quality.
intro.philosophy: Build once. Build properly. Build for the people who will use it long after we have gone.
intro.imageAlt: Engineers reviewing structural drawings on a construction site
intro.imageCaption: Structural review — drawing coordination ahead of a concrete pour.

mission.missionBody: To deliver construction and engineering work that our clients can rely on without qualification — technically sound, financially disciplined, and completed with the care of people who will have to live with the result.
mission.visionBody: To be the engineering partner of choice across the region: the firm international clients call when a project is complex, the schedule is demanding, and there is no room for a second attempt.
mission.value1Body: Calculations and specifications we are willing to put our name to, and to defend publicly.
mission.value2Body: One team owns the outcome. Responsibility is never passed down the chain.
mission.value3Body: Cost, programme and risk stated plainly, including when the news is unwelcome.
mission.value4Body: No milestone is worth an injury. Safe sites are also productive sites.

about.metaDescription: Who Meridian is, how we work, and the standards we hold ourselves to as a construction and engineering company.
about.heading: An engineering company that happens to build.
about.lead: Meridian was formed on a straightforward premise: that construction projects fail for organisational reasons far more often than technical ones. We built a company designed to remove those organisational failure points.
about.overviewBody1: We operate as an integrated contractor. Structural, mechanical, electrical and civil engineering teams sit within the same organisation as our site delivery and procurement functions. Information does not have to cross a contractual boundary to be acted upon.
about.overviewBody2: That structure is deliberate. It means a design change is costed by the people who will build it, before it is approved. It means a procurement delay is visible to the planner the day it happens, not the week after.
about.overviewBody3: The result is a company that can commit to a programme with confidence, and that says so honestly when a commitment is not achievable.
about.approachStep1Body: We interrogate the brief, the site and the constraints before we price anything. A proposal built on assumptions is a liability for both sides.
about.approachStep2Body: Buildability is reviewed at concept stage. The cheapest drawing is worthless if it cannot be built safely or economically.
about.approachStep3Body: The critical path is owned by a named planner and reviewed weekly with the client. Slippage is reported immediately.
about.approachStep4Body: Inspection and test plans define what must be proven before work proceeds. Nothing is covered up unverified.
about.approachStep5Body: As-built records, O&M documentation, warranties and training delivered together — not chased for months afterwards.
about.commitmentsTitle: What we will not compromise on.
about.commitment1Body: Every worker goes home. Method statements, permits and daily briefings are non-negotiable, not paperwork.
about.commitment2Title: Accuracy of what we tell you
about.commitment2Body: Programmes and costs we believe in. If we are uncertain, we say so before we sign, not after.
about.commitment3Body: Defects are closed before handover, not logged for a later visit. The building should be right on day one.
about.commitment4Title: Fair dealing with our supply chain
about.commitment4Body: Prompt payment and clear scopes. Our subcontractors' stability is our own programme security.
about.imageAlt: Aerial view of a large construction site with organised work zones

privacy.metaDescription: How Meridian Construction & Engineering collects, uses and protects personal data.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy.
privacy.lead: How we collect, use, store and protect personal information submitted through this website.
privacy.notice: This policy is a structural template. It must be reviewed and approved by the company's legal advisers before publication.
privacy.section1Body: We collect information you provide directly through our enquiry, partnership, tender and career application forms. This typically includes your name, email address, telephone number, organisation and the content of your message. Where you submit a job application, we also collect the CV and any attachments you provide.
privacy.section2Body: Your information is used solely to respond to your enquiry, evaluate a partnership or tender submission, assess a job application, or meet legal and regulatory obligations. We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for automated decision-making or profiling.
privacy.section3Body: We process personal data on the basis of your consent when you submit a form, our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries, and our legal obligations where applicable. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it at any time.
privacy.section4Body: Submissions are stored securely and retained only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which they were collected, or as required by applicable law. Application materials are retained for the duration of the recruitment process and for a reasonable period afterwards unless you ask us to delete them.
privacy.section5Body: We share personal data only with service providers who process it on our behalf under written instruction, such as hosting and email delivery providers, and only to the extent necessary. We do not disclose personal data to third parties for their own marketing purposes.
privacy.section6Body: We apply technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including encryption in transit, access controls, and role-based permissions limiting who may view submitted information. Access is reviewed regularly.
privacy.section7Body: This website uses strictly necessary cookies to remember your language preference and to maintain an authenticated session in the administration area. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are set. You can clear cookies at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.section8Body: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you, to request correction of inaccuracies, to request erasure, to object to or restrict processing, and to receive your data in a portable format. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacy.section9Body: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Material changes will be indicated by an updated revision date at the top of this page.
privacy.section10Body: If you have questions about this policy or how your data is handled, contact our head office using the details on our contact page.
